item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Chariot
  • 発売日: 2012-02-24
  • スコア: 6.87/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 処女と魔王とタクティクス ～魔王争奪戦～
  • 英語名: Shojo to Maou to Tactics Maou Soudatsusen

あらすじ

After the main (Elis) route of the prequel

Tatsuya, Marie and Saya returned to their world after defeating the armies of the Goddess in Cielo Pantasia. However, Tatsuya, on a whim, pulled Elis into the magical circle while they were teleporting, so now the four of them are at Tatsuya and Marie’s house, with their parents.

item.title: Shojo to Maou to Tactics
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Chariot
  • 発売日: 2011-06-24
  • スコア: 7.109999999999999/10 (69 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 処女と魔王とタクティクス
  • 英語名: Shojo to Maou to Tactics

别名

  • Virgin and Beelzebub and Tactics

あらすじ

This fantasy SRPG is the debut title from Chariot. Tatsuya doesn’t have many redeeming qualities other than being earnest. One day, the soul of a maou went into his body and willingly turned into a guy who loves to pick fights. Then while he was dealing with some delinquents from the neighbouring town, he was suddenly summoned to another world. In front of him was the new maou, Elis, who begged him to save the demon race from the angels. He gladly agrees to, in exchange for her virginity.
